title: Mexican-Style Pan-Seared Fish with Ochazuke Rice
description: A fusion dish combining Mexican flavors with Japanese ochazuke rice, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. Prepare ochazuke rice according to package instructions.
2. In a small bowl, mix together lime juice, cumin, chili powder, and garlic.
3. Season fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
4. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Transfer cooked fish to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
7. Add the lime juice mixture to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
8. Serve fish with ochazuke rice and spoon the lime juice sauce over the top.
9. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
